Theorem
[Sharp logarithmic Sobolev inequality (Theorem 27.46)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0047, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0048, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0049 ↗ def:chow-iv-shrinker-entropy 1. ch27:27.46\group Logarithmic Sobolev inequality

For every complete noncompact shrinker, \[ \inf _\varphi \mathcal W(g,\varphi )=\mu (\mathcal G)=-C_1(\mathcal G). \] Equivalently, if $\int w^2=(4\pi )^{n/2}$, \[ \int (Rw^2+4|\nabla w|^2-w^2\log w^2)\, d\mu \ge (n-C_1(\mathcal G))\int w^2d\mu . \]
